attchmntText: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited filed an investor presentation for the period ended 30th September 2026. For Q2 FY27, net operating revenue was Rs. 502.99 crore, compared to Rs. 503.24 crore in Q2 FY26. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 24.26 crore versus a loss of Rs. 13.48 crore in the prior year period. Profit after tax was Rs. 12.48 crore against a loss of Rs. 8.77 crore. Earnings per share were Rs. 1.94 compared to Rs. 1.36. Sugar realization increased to Rs. 45608 per ton from Rs. 39956 per ton. Ethanol sales rose to 166.76 lakh BL from 132.47 lakh BL. Sugar sales decreased to 0.67 lakh tons from 0.80 lakh tons. Chemical sales fell to 58.12 lakh kg from 87.53 lakh kg. Potable spirits sales dropped to 6.98 lakh cases from 8.18 lakh cases. The company paid an interim dividend of 20%. Diversification into the NBFC vertical is approved subject to statutory approvals.

attchmntText: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  BAHADUR MURAO & CO. as Other of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company appointed Bahadur Murao & Co. as Cost Auditor to fill a casual vacancy. The long-stop date for the acquisition of 51% equity share capital of Venus India Asset-Finance Private Limited was extended from October 28, 2026, to March 31, 2027. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 694.44 Crores, with a net profit of 12.62 Crores. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 1,480.61 Crores, and net profit was 18.71 Crores. Earnings per share for the quarter was 1.96, and for the six months, it was 2.9. The board meeting concluded at 5:30 P.M. on November 14, 2026.

attchmntText: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited board meeting held on November 14, 2026, approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated net profit of 18.71 Crores for the six months ended September 30, 2026. Bahadur Murao and Co. was appointed as Cost Auditor to fill a casual vacancy. The long-stop date for the acquisition of 51 percent equity share capital of Venus India Asset-Finance Private Limited was extended from October 28, 2026, to March 31, 2027.

attchmntText: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Demise of Mr Surendra Rai Kapur, Other of the company on October 18, 2026.
